title: Understanding Agglomerative Clustering
text: Agglomerative clustering starts with each point as its own cluster and merges the closest clusters step by step. The distance between clusters is defined as the maximum distance between points in the clusters.

title: Finding the Closest Clusters
text: Look at the distance matrix. Identify the smallest non-zero distance, as this indicates the closest pair of clusters to merge.

title: Identifying the Smallest Distance
text: Which pair of points has the smallest distance between them?

title: Merging Clusters
text: Once you identify the closest pair, merge them into a single cluster. The new cluster is named after the lowest letter in the pair.
